SITE / PRIVACY

PRIVACY.

A concise explanation of the data handling visible in the current READY/ storefront.

Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe. This storefront does not collect card details. Stripe may collect information required to process the transaction and prevent fraud under its own privacy terms.

Accounts

The current READY/ storefront does not require a customer account to browse the site or use the free tools.

Free tools

The current free-tool experience is presented without an email gate. Information you enter into a browser-based calculator or check should not be treated as a secure place to store sensitive personal information.

Fonts

The current site loads the Inter typeface through Google Fonts. When the page loads, your browser requests the relevant stylesheet and font files from Google-hosted font services.

Scope / This page describes the current launch storefront. If the site later adds accounts, mailing lists, analytics or other data-processing features, this notice should be updated to describe them.

Page reviewed: 28 October 2026.
